name: yacht-twilight-blondie
image_vibe: quiet, playful, relaxed evening on the water
image_purpose: show an authentic twilight boat moment with a drink and phone prop

prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with messy shoulder-length blonde hair, freckles and natural skin texture, seated comfortably on white yacht cushions. She wears a modest white ruched dress with criss-cross halter straps, a simple silver cross necklace, and holds a partially filled wine glass. Keep her expression playful and relaxed, not seductive.
prompt.composition_elements: Mid-shot from mid-thigh upward, polished stainless railings, calm dark-blue ocean, muted twilight sky, smartphone resting face-down on cushion. Natural eye-level framing with gentle background softness.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused evening ambient light mixed with subtle boat lights and twilight sky, flattering but realistic highlights, no harsh shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic candid lifestyle photography, natural skin and fabric folds, accurate hands, realistic glass and phone, cool blue background with warm neutral skin and dress tones.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic twilight yacht lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult blonde woman with freckles and natural skin texture, seated comfortably on white cushions in a modest white ruched dress and simple silver cross necklace, holding a wine glass, calm dark-blue ocean, stainless railings, muted twilight sky, smartphone on cushion, relaxed playful expression, realistic candid photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, cleavage emphasis, seductive mouth gesture, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: yacht-twilight-blondie-reference
assets.usage: Match the subject, wardrobe, vehicle setting, composition, lighting, and travel mood. Replaceable with another approved yacht reference for the same concept.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic approved adult identity cues, wardrobe category, pose, yacht environment, lighting, and vacation story. Optional replacement references may change hair, colors, accessories, props, or skyline while retaining the concept. Keep products and logos replaceable or neutral; no typography.
